title: Early Versus Late Catheter Removal in Patients With Acute Urinary Retention Secondary to BPH Under Tamsulosin Treatment
brief_summary: The aim of this work is to compare between early (3days) and late(7days) removal of urinary catheter after acute urine retention in patients with Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia under Tamsulosin treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients having first attack of acute urinary retention secondary to BPH.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Renal impairment.
* Suspected urethral stricture.
* Neurogenic bladder.
* Cancer prostate.
* Medically induced retention.
* Previous use of alpha blockers.
* History of drug hypersensitivity or allergy to Tamsulosin.
